travelerPickup.additionalInfo: We try and pick up at all accommodations but on our group tours we have to consider other passengers enduring long detours so may ask people to rendezvous somewhere on route. We pick up from rentals, hostels and wine lodges within Greater Mendoza area- Please contact us to check the exact pick up time.

description:
This is a luxury, small group (nine people) wine tour of Mendoza´s fine wine region.  

We spend the day visiting the very best wineries (three to four in one day) and trying the best wines in the most beautiful locations. 

A multiple course gourmet lunch with wine pairings is included. 

A guide accompanies you throughout the day and gives insights and anecdotes regarding wine and Mendoza. 

Many of our guides are trained sommeliers or winemakers. The tour is in one language and the wineries and region (Lujan de Cuyo or Uco Valley) differ from day-to-day as there are many amazing places to see. 

Our tours are fun and casual with the focus on exceptional wines, creative food and stunning settings. The wineries we visit differ from day to day but are from a select group of top-quality producers.

itinerary.unstructuredDescription: Pick up is at 8.45am at your hotel in the Mendoza City area.  We visit three wineries throughout the day and have premum tastings including Malbec at each winery.  At the first winery we also do a tour of the facility to see what makes Argentine so unique. Each winery we visit is very different and we include small boutique operations and larger, big name wineries. We then have a 5-course gourmet lunch with 5 wines at a winery with beautiful mountan views. We return to your Mendoza City hotel at 5.30pm.  The group size is maximum eight people and the price includes tastings and lunch with wine. A guide accompanies you all day and the tour is conducted in an air-conditioned Mercedes mini-bus.  Mineral water is provided in the transport vehicle.
